Name: OrangePie's DCBurger style Lady Sheba (East Scarp cat NPC) Portrait
Author: OrangePieUwU
Description:
High res portrait of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url] mod stray cat NPC Lady Sheba, Since I use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745]DCBurger's Portrait[/url] for the main game I tried to draw in style that fits with DCBurger's portrait. 

I haven't unlocked Lady Sheba myself so the screenshots are not actual screenshots, just something to showcase how it'd look in-game.

*Make sure you have [b]PyTK[/b] mod (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726)*
[b][size=4]PYTK unofficial update for 1.5.5: [url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000]https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/page-78#post-53000[/url]﻿[/size][/b]
Find where you installed your East Scarp mod (somewhere in [b]Stardew Valley\Mods[/b] folder)
Drag the "[b][CP] East Scarp NPCs[/b]" folder from my zip to the [b]Stardew Valley\Mods\East Scarp 2.0[/b] folder to overwrite the folder in it to install.

[b][size=3]*This mod only includes Lady Sheba, for the other East Scrap NPC portraits and incoming Animal NPC portraits please go download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/113370488]lunakatt[/url]'s awesome [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9612]lunakatt's DCBurger style portraits for East Scarp (East Scarpe)[/url] portraits.[/size][/b]


Uploaded CP version.
*I would still recommend the replacement file version as the assets don't get loaded 2 times and are lighter to run.

Added another version in the optional file for people who want to install the portraits with portraiture.



Need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url] to work. (And ofc [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url] mod.)



The character belongs to the creator of  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url]: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68088657]lemurkat[/url], please go give them Endorsements and loves.
Please go give Endorsements and loves to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/113370488]lunakatt[/url]'s lovely [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9612]lunakatt's DCBurger style portraits for East Scarp (East Scarpe)[/url] too :D
